text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition Labour Party leader Alfred Sant says his party prepared to fight electoral campaign "calmly and civilly" but warns ruling Nationalist Party not to resort to personal attacks.
- State-owned energy corporation, Enemalta, is seeking to solve distribution problems that have caused power blackouts in the past few months.
- Opposition leader Alfred Sant promises "a government for all the people". Malta must have elections by the end of June 1997 but they are expected earlier than that.
- Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami, winding up official Independence Day celebrations, says sister island of Gozo on right road for development.
